The '''Ruugia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Altier sector/Legends|Altier sector]], a part of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] regions known as the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]].<ref name="Slice" /> It was the origin point of the [[Ruugian noodle]]s.<ref name="Platt">''[[Platt's Starport Guide]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Ruugian noodle]]s|system=Ruugia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Ruugia system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square O-13.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
